# ListInsetControl

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:list-inset-control` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

Insets selected physical sides of a self-bordered control in a pane/list content region.

## When to use

Apply the standard 8px outer margin to all physical sides of a self-bordered control by default, or only the sides selected with the canonical Sides contract.

- Place a control that carries its own border and padding (an input, a wa-\* control) in a pane/list content region so its edges align with .kui-content items.

**Not when:**

- Do not wrap a component that already owns its content-item margin (ListItem, StateBanner, …) — that double-insets it. Use ListInsetText for bare text.

**Alternatives:**

- [ListInsetText](./list-inset-text.md) (nearest)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/list-inset-control` — exports `ListInsetControl`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/list-inset-control` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/list-inset-control.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/list-inset-control`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuilist-inset-control) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- all-side inset by default
- top/right/bottom/left inset combinations

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the wrapped control and its behavior.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: child · padding: child (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- A layout wrapper only; it adds no role or name — the wrapped control keeps its own.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-list-inset-control`.

Never put `kui-list-inset-control` on an element you write; render `ListInsetControl` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-layout-inline-margin`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
